transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

I came in because I’m just worn out all the time. Even if I spend a full night in bed, I wake up feeling like my body is made of sandbags. Getting through a workday takes everything I have, and even something like folding laundry feels like too much.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in your usual activities?

Yes. I used to make time for things like hiking, yoga, working in my garden, taking bird photos… but lately I just keep canceling or putting it off. My camera’s been sitting in the closet. None of it really feels worth the effort right now.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or like you’re not worth much lately?

Yes. I keep going over this mortgage decision we made, and I tell myself I was selfish and reckless, like I put our whole household at risk. My husband keeps reminding me we made the choice together, but I still feel like it’s my fault.
Have you ever felt so overwhelmed or hopeless that you’ve thought about hurting yourself or that life isn’t worth living?
Yes… mostly late at night. I catch myself thinking my husband might be better off without me. I haven’t made any plan or anything like that, but the thought keeps coming back, and it scares me.
